Records.description: massless propagator computed for the $\varphi^4$ 6-loop calculation available from the ancillary files p_int_g4.mpl (Maple) and p_int_g4.m (Mathematica) of the arXiv submission results are rational linear combinations of multiple zeta values. The pInt[4,26] period for this 4-loop 8-propagator topology is imported here as a Result: value = Cfull^4 * (anc g4 period). The Cfull^4 normalization and the overall sign sigma = (-1)^#edges are normalization-anchored at 4 loops by independent pySD-Euclidean s=-1 on an even-#edges and an odd-#edges diagram; this sibling follows from the same diagram-independent conversion and the explicit CNI->anc bridge isomorphism, and is not independently integrated per-target.
Records.verifiedVia: normalization-anchored (validation policy 2026-06-22; the per-target pySD-Euclidean firewall is retired for siblings of an anchored loop order). value_ST = Cfull^4 * anc[pInt[4,26]], with Cfull = Exp[eps*EulerGamma] Gamma[1+eps] Gamma[1-eps]^2/Gamma[2-2eps] -- a fixed, DIAGRAM-INDEPENDENT function of eps converting the ancillary G-scheme normalization to the SubTropica normalization per loop, so Cfull^4 is identical for every 4-loop target. The normalization Cfull^4 and the overall-sign rule sigma = (-1)^nu_tot = (-1)^#edges are INDEPENDENTLY ANCHORED at 4 loops by pySD-Euclidean s=-1 on two diagrams split by edge parity: even-#edges (sigma=+1) anchor [1122|34|34|e|e| (pInt[4,16], irreducible double-box core, g4 8-prop, sigma=+1)]; odd-#edges (sigma=-1) anchor [1112|3|e33|e| (pInt[4,3], g2 7-prop, sigma=-1)]. For this 8-propagator target sigma = +1 = (-1)^8. The ancillary period value is from Kompaniets-Panzer (arXiv:1705.06483; peer-reviewed HyperInt computation; trusted). The CNI->anc bridge is confirmed by an explicit vertex isomorphism {1->4, 2->5, 3->2, 4->3, 5->1} (anc->lib; brute-force) (brute force: the library graph is isomorphic to the anc Nickel graph), with the valence-4 gate and leading pole eps^-3 (within the valid divergent range -4 <= lead <= 0; the genuine-period identity is guaranteed by the bridge isomorphism + the trusted ancillary value, NOT by the pole order). This target is NOT independently integrated per-target; its value-affecting correctness rests on the anchored normalization + the trusted ancillary value + the exact bridge. NOT validated against HyperFLINT/STIntegrate (a HyperInt reimplementation -> circular).

source.title: Minimally subtracted six loop renormalization of O(n)-symmetric phi^4 theory and critical exponents
source.ancFile: anc/p_int_g4.m -> pInt[4,26]  (g4 = IRR-rearranged auxiliary integrals; valence-4 verified and equal to the unit-power period of this graph by the loop-order normalization anchor + the explicit CNI->anc bridge isomorphism (NOT per-target pySD); NOT phi^4 self-energies)

import.method: Single-scale phi^4 propagator integral, external scale restored. value = (p^2)^{0 - 4 eps} * Cfull^4 * anc[pInt[4,26]]: the KP G-scheme period series (Cfull = Exp[eps*EulerGamma] Gamma[1+eps] Gamma[1-eps]^2/Gamma[2-2eps], G-scheme -> SubTropica normalization per loop) with the external Euclidean invariant restored, so the stored value is the dimensionful momentum-space integral, not the p^2=1 reduced form. g4: IRR-rearranged auxiliary p-integral (NOT a phi^4 self-energy); 2L-V=0; I ~ (p2)^{-4 eps}; log-divergent, dimensionless. p2 = -MM > 0 : the spacelike (mostly-plus) external invariant, = minus the package mostly-minus Euclidean MM (MM<0; conventions.md L918-924). value = (p2)^{0 - 4 eps} * (dimensionless p2=1 form) is REAL for p2>0 (KP G-scheme). At the pySD anchor MM=-1, i.e. p2=+1, the scale factor is 1, reproducing the anchored period; the i*pi tower appears only on continuation to timelike p2<0 (MM>0). NOT computed by STIntegrate/HyperFLINT (a HyperInt reimplementation; using it to validate the ancillary HyperInt value would be circular).
